findings.description: `createSaveAll` sets `downloadNext` to `true` after a non-`AbortError` share failure, but `tap()` never clears it after the fallback batch. Every later tap skips `canShare` and goes to downloads, including taps after newly received photos, while the existing rejection test stops before that behavior is exposed.
findings.title: Save all keeps downloading after one failed share sheet

citations.citation: let downloadNext = false;   // the share sheet failed: the next tap downloads instead
Prevent missed or duplicate handovers on retry

evidence.explanation: The share-failure catch sets `downloadNext`, and the selection gate in `tap()` reads it on later taps; the download branch never resets it. The rejection test covers the first fallback batch but does not check whether a subsequent tap attempts sharing again.

findings.description: `tap()` snapshots the files to download and does not recheck `handed` after each wait, while individual `save(p)` can download and mark one of those files during that wait. On a device without file sharing, tapping a print before its turn in a running Save all batch starts its download immediately, and the batch downloads it again.
findings.title: One photo downloads twice during a batch

evidence.explanation: Individual Save starts a download and adds the PID to the shared set. Save all takes its ready snapshot once, waits between downloads, and downloads each snapshotted entry without consulting that set again.

findings.description: `saveBatch` derives its still-arriving count solely from `incoming`, but the chunk handler deletes that entry before `done()` awaits checksum verification. A tap during verification sees the photo in neither `incoming` nor `files`, so Save all can say `Nothing new to save` even though the photo is still being finalized.
findings.title: Finishing photos vanish from the count

evidence.explanation: The chunk handler removes the incoming entry before calling the asynchronous validator. The file is installed only after its awaited checksum, whereas Save all counts only current incoming entries and installed files.

findings.description: `createSaveAll.tap()` clears `busy` only when its awaited share promise settles, with no recovery path for one that remains pending. If the browser leaves that promise unsettled, every later Save all tap returns `Still saving` and cannot hand over the available photos.
findings.title: An unsettled share locks out later taps

evidence.explanation: The busy guard rejects subsequent taps, and the only reset is a `finally` block reached after the awaited share settles. The page supplies the browser's share promise directly.

findings.description: `createSaveAll.tap()` catches a synchronous download failure with `console.warn` but leaves the earlier `Downloading N` toast unchanged. If creating the object URL or clicking its link throws, the photo remains eligible for retry, but the person is not told that its download did not start.
findings.title: Failed downloads go unnoticed

evidence.explanation: The batch announces its full count before attempting any downloads, while its per-file catch writes only to the console. The wired download helper can throw synchronously while creating or clicking its link.
